# authwise_certificate (Data Source)

A certificate and, when kit minted it, its private key. The trust anchor SAML connections verify signatures against, and the client certificate an endpoint presents for mTLS. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `certificate_pem` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String)
- `has_private_key` (Boolean)
- `import_certificate_pem` (String) `import_certificate_pem` is input only: the API consumes it and never returns it, so this data source always reads it as null.
- `key_id` (String)
- `key_size` (Number) `key_size` is input only: the API consumes it and never returns it, so this data source always reads it as null.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `not_after` (String)
- `not_before` (String)
- `origin` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `subject` (String)
- `subject_common_name` (String) `subject_common_name` is input only: the API consumes it and never returns it, so this data source always reads it as null.
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `use` (String)
- `validity_days` (Number) `validity_days` is input only: the API consumes it and never returns it, so this data source always reads it as null.
